run_unconditional_crystal_generation: run unconditional crystal structure generation using a fine-tuned Llama model and save CIF outputs to CSV
run_conditional_crystal_generation: run conditional crystal structure generation using a conditions CSV file with formula, energy, and spacegroup constraints
run_infill_element_swap: run infill sampling to swap elements in a crystal structure and generate valid replacement CIFs
parse_crystal_text_to_cif: parse a generated crystal description string into lattice parameters, species, and coordinates as a CIF file
resize_llama_tokenizer_embeddings: resize a Llama tokenizer and model embeddings to add special tokens like PAD, EOS, BOS, and UNK
